notes.title: ASDA STORY WISHLIST EVENT !
notes.content:

📢 Dear Adventurers!

The ASDA STORY team has prepared a special Steam Wishlist Event!
Add [ASDA STORY] to your wishlist and unlock exciting community rewards! 🎁

🔹 Current Unlocked Reward
✅ 5,000 Wishlists – 🎖 Exclusive In-Game Title

🔒 Next Goals & Rewards
🚀 10,000 / 30,000 / 50,000 / 100,000 Wishlists – New rewards will be revealed as we reach each goal!

🎯 Help us unlock more rewards!
Visit the ASDA STORY store and wishlist now! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3011820/ASDA_STORY/][Steam Store Link][/url]
We’ll share updates whenever a new goal is reached.

🏆 Rewards will be distributed after the official game launch.

※ The event reward payment method is subject to change.
※ The event ends when the final goal is reached, otherwise, it may end prematurely.
